content.user_title: Find Cabin Floor Plans and Download Links
content.value_statement: Finding cabin concepts with comparable layouts and downloadable files takes time. This skill guides searches, comparisons, and download retrieval through the AI Architectures plan library.
actual_capabilities: Searches the connected plan library with a cabin query and requested bedroom, story, or garage filters.
Presents three to six matching plans with area, bedrooms, bathrooms, stories, images, and page links.
Converts square meters to approximate square feet using the supplied conversion factor.
Retrieves available PDF, DXF, IFC, and GLB links for a selected plan through get_house_plan.
Relaxes one search filter at a time when results do not fit, explaining each change.
limitations: Search and download retrieval require a working external AI Architectures MCP connector.
Library size, free access, account requirements, and download availability are service claims, not independently verified guarantees.
Plans are concepts, not permit documents, construction documents, or proof of local code compliance.
Custom drawing is delegated to the separate floor-plan-cad skill, which is not included.

use_cases.title: Compare Small Cabin Concepts
use_cases.description: Review compact cabin layouts with room counts, areas, and floor plan images before choosing a concept.

use_cases.title: Gather Early Design References
use_cases.description: Find cabin precedents and retrieve available CAD or model downloads for an initial design discussion.

use_cases.title: Explore Layout Tradeoffs
use_cases.description: Compare bedroom and story options, then broaden filters when the connected library has limited matches.

prompt_templates.title: Browse Cabin Concepts
prompt_templates.prompt: Find three cabin concepts and show their floor plan images, areas, room counts, and page links.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Cabin Layouts
prompt_templates.prompt: Find single-story cabins with two bedrooms. Compare up to six results and include approximate square feet.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve Plan Downloads
prompt_templates.prompt: For the cabin I selected, retrieve available PDF, DXF, IFC, and GLB download links. Note any formats that are unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Broaden a Constrained Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for two-bedroom, single-story cabins with a garage. If none match, relax one filter at a time and explain each change.

output_examples.input: Find a cabin with two bedrooms and one story.
output: Illustrative response when no exact matches are returned:
No plans match both requested filters.
I will keep two bedrooms and remove the single-story filter for the next search.
Any matching plans will include their reported stories, area, floor plan image, and page link.

output_examples.input: Can I use the selected concept to apply for a building permit?
output: This plan is a concept, not a permit or construction document.
A licensed professional must evaluate local codes and determine the documents required for your site.
Available plan downloads can support that initial discussion.

best_practices: Approve the external connector before setup and share only project details needed for the search.
Start with required bedroom, story, or garage filters; review any filter changes before accepting broader results.
Check download availability and consult a licensed professional before using a concept for a building project.
anti_patterns: Treating conceptual layouts as approved construction or permit documents.
Assuming every plan has every download format or that service access will remain unchanged.
Expecting this skill alone to create custom drawings, validate structures, or resolve site-specific code requirements.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The listing supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Tool access requires a compatible client configured with the external MCP connector.

faq.question: Does the skill include the plan library?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions for searching the external AI Architectures service through search_house_plans and get_house_plan.

faq.question: Are the plans free?
faq.answer: The source describes free downloads without an account. Current availability and access terms depend on the external service.

faq.question: Which download formats does it request?
faq.answer: It requests available PDF plan sets, DXF drawings, IFC models, and GLB models for the selected plan.

faq.question: Can these plans be used directly for construction?
faq.answer: No. The source identifies them as concepts. Local codes and a licensed professional determine what can be built.

faq.question: What happens when no plan matches?
faq.answer: The workflow loosens one filter at a time and explains the change. It may suggest the separate floor-plan-cad skill for custom drawing.
